stemMd: What did operating both survey methods together reveal?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Visual observers were always more accurate.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Rain eliminated every animal from the sites.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The relationship between their counts differed with conditions such as recent rain.

explanationMd: The overlapping season showed similar site rankings on dry nights but a changed relationship after rain. This directly undermines the idea that a single average multiplier can bridge the methods.

distractorRationale.b: No universal accuracy ranking is established.
distractorRationale.c: Movement and visibility changed, not total existence.
distractorRationale.a: The passage discusses habitat-related detection differences.
